who: claude-opus-5-5 (Claude Opus 5.5), lane K2a of the no-daemon command; workaround by the no-op lane the same day
where: crates/blaze-command/src/run.rs (check: gather, then the request) against blaze-host's Request::late and blaze-keyed's Front
what: `check --no-daemon` had to gather every unit's text (read, hash and image every file, the standard library's included) before the host could say the certificate holds, because Request::late takes every unit's late table up front and the late tables come out of the gathered text. A no-op therefore cost the whole checkout's parse instead of a sweep and one certificate lookup. Beside it: blaze-query's Tree::file has no IO error, only Corrupt, so the command's DiskTree keeps IO failures in a side channel and turns them into an error after each plan answer; and blaze_lower::crates::cfg is pub(crate), so the unit cfg flag assembly is written a second time in blaze-command's graph.rs.
cost: not measured: the gather is a phase of its own in the command's summary (`gather`); the look that skips it is the `look` phase
cause: the driver's seam asks for late tables eagerly, before it knows whether any unit is keyed, and the certificate lookup lives only inside host::run
whys: late tables are an input of the request; the request is built before the certificate lookup; the certificate lookup lives inside host::run; nothing on the Front seam lets the driver ask a unit's late table when it first keys the unit
class: an input the request takes up front that is only needed on a certificate miss puts a miss's cost on every no-op
prevention: not done: let blaze_host::run take a certificate look made before it (a `Found` or the certified manifests), so the look runs once; key a unit whose files did not move from its kept manifest (late table included) so a miss gathers only moved units; make Tree::file able to say an IO error; make blaze_lower::crates::cfg public and call it
workaround: run::check looks the certificate up itself (run::look_up, blaze_keyed::outside::Lookup over blaze_host::outside::Answerer) before gathering, and gathers nothing on a hit: a no-op is the sweep and two certificate lookups; a miss still gathers every unit
